title: Ethnic group (20 categories) by local authority
description: Census 2021 usual residents in England and Wales by ethnic group, counted for each lower tier local authority. ONS table TS021, 2021 edition, version 3.

files.note: 331 local authorities x 20 ethnic groups, 6,620 rows. Ethnic group code -8 is the 'Does not apply' row and is skipped by the loader. Versions 1-3 carry identical observations; v3 only downcased the two geography column headers, so the loader keys on 'Lower tier local authorities Code' and would read nothing from a v1 or v2 file.
